title: Seriously Slushy by Doozy Vape 100ml Shortfill 0mg (70VG/30PG)
description:
True to their name, Seriously Slushy bring you a selection of delicate and fresh fruit flavours mixed into an icy slush.
– Made in the UK
– 0mg Nicotine Strength
– 100ml E-liquid Content in a 120ml Shortfill Bottle
– Space for 2 x 18mg Nicotine shots for 3mg
– 70VG/30PG
– Childproof and Tamper evident cap
– Suitable for Sub Ohm Vaping
– Recyclable Bottle
– TPD compliant
Flavours:
Berry Watermelon
A Juicy Mix of Ripe Strawberries and Slices of Red Watermelon make this stunning Cool Combination, irresistible!
Grape Soda
Crispy Red and White Grapes with crushed Ice and a Mix of Sweet Soda make this a tasty All day Vape.
Lemon Lime
A Refreshing Citrus Combination of Zesty Lemons, a cube of Ice and a Splash of Lime with a Deliciously Sweet Edge.
Lime Berry
A Tongue Tingling Mix of Berries with a sharp but Sweet Drizzle of Lime Sorbet and a touch of Ice.
Mixed Berries
A Concoction of Succulent Red, Blue and Black Berries perfectly combined with a light coolness to make your mouth water!
Raspberry Tangerine
Mouth-watering Combination of Juicy Raspberries Drenched in Cold freshly squeezed Tangerines
